newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia July trade deficit at 624.5 mln ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia July trade deficit at 624.5 mln ringgit.

text.p: Malaysia recorded a trade deficit of 624.5 million ringgit in July 1996 against a surplus of 574.1 million in June 1996 and a 1.34 billion ringgit deficit in July 1995, the Statistics Department said on Monday.
Malaysian financial markets have been expecting a July trade gap of up to one billion ringgit.
Quoting a July report from the Statistics Department, Bernama said the June 1996 trade figure was revised to a surplus of 551.4 million ringgit.
The department said that imports for the month were 16.5 billion ringgit versus exports of 15.9 billion ringgit.
In the first seven months of the year, Malaysia recorded a trade deficit of 1.4 billion ringgit versus a gap of 6.9 billion ringgit in the same period a year ago.
Over the first seven months, exports grew by 11 percent to 112.4 billion ringgit while imports rose 5.2 percent to 113.8 billion ringgit.
electronic valves and tubes and related products continued to be the major source of revenue, with receipt amounting to 21 billion ringgit or 18.7 percent of total export value.
The top three destinations for Malaysia's exports in the first seven months of 1996 were Singapore (22.6 billion ringgit), the United States (21.6 billion ringgit) and Japan (15.2 billion ringgit).
